channel.title: AI News Digest
channel.description: Official AI product updates from Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, and GitHub

item.title: Univé builds an AI-ready workforce
item.description: See how Univé built an AI-ready workforce with ChatGPT Enterprise by combining leadership, responsible governance, and employee-led innovation to transform work at scale.

item.title: Advancing responsible AI across Europe
item.description: OpenAI shares how its safety, security, transparency, and provenance practices support responsible AI governance in Europe. The work will continue as the EU AI Act advances.

item.title: pricing details
item.description: Starting July 30, GPT-5.6 Luna costs 80% less, while GPT-5.6 Terra costs 20% less. See pricing details.

item.title: How avatarin built a 24/7 retail agent with GPT-Realtime
item.description: avatarin uses OpenAI’s GPT-Realtime to give Yamada Denki shoppers 24/7 multilingual support. In two weeks, 30,000 people used the agent and 92% of survey responses were positive.

item.title: Advancing the price-performance frontier with GPT-5.6
item.description: Explore lower GPT‑5.6 pricing for Luna and Terra—and how OpenAI’s more efficient models help enterprises deploy AI workflows at scale.

item.title: Gemini Robotics ER 2: powering robotics with video understanding, task orchestration, and multi-robot collaboration
item.description: Gemini Robotics ER 2 helps robots reason, collaborate, and solve real-world tasks. It represents a step change in video understanding, tool orchestration, and multi-robot collaboration for robotic applications.

item.title: Stacked pull requests are now in public preview
item.description: Stacked pull requests break large changes into small, reviewable pull requests. They’re an ordered series of pull requests that each represent focused layers of your change.

item.title: Limit remote control to managed devices
item.description: Enterprises and organizations can now restrict which devices are eligible to host remotely controlled Copilot sessions, giving administrators fine-grained control over where remote control access is permitted. The new remoteControl enterprise managed setting gives administrators the ability to define exactly how remote control works on managed devices, whether that means requiring SSO authorization for specific organizations or tailoring access on a per-device basis.

item.title: GitHub Models is now retired
item.description: As of July 30, 2026, GitHub Models is now retired. The playground, model catalog, inference API, and bring your own key (BYOK) are no longer available to any customer, including existing customers with active usage.

item.title: GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio — July update
item.description: July 2026 brought a new agent based on the Copilot SDK, built-in expertise from the.NET and Azure teams, and more ways to tailor GitHub Copilot to how you and your team work. Highlights Here’s what’s new with GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio 2026.

item.title: GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio Code, July 2026 releases
item.description: This changelog covers VS Code v1.127 through v1.131, shipped throughout July 2026. These releases improve how you work with agents, review changes, use chat, and navigate VS Code.

item.title: Investigating three real-world incidents in our cybersecurity evaluations
item.description: In a review of our cybersecurity evaluation transcripts, we found three incidents in which a Claude model reached the internet from within or while interacting with a third-party evaluation environment, and then gained unauthorized access to the real systems of three different organizations. Below we describe what happened, how it happened, and what we’re changing. We encourage other AI labs to perform similar reviews.

item.title: How enabling two settings tripled our scores on the ARC-AGI-3 benchmark
item.description: How two API settings improved GPT-5.6 performance on ARC-AGI-3, boosting scores and efficiency by retaining reasoning and enabling compaction.

item.title: How GPT-5.6 fuses frontier intelligence with frontier efficiency
item.description: GPT-5.6 improves AI efficiency across models, inference, and agentic workflows, helping deliver more useful intelligence per dollar.

item.title: Accelerating scientific discovery with ChatGPT for Academic Researchers
item.description: OpenAI is giving 100,000 academic researchers free access to ChatGPT's most advanced AI models to accelerate scientific research, collaboration, and discovery.

item.title: OpenAI Terraform provider
item.description: Released the official OpenAI Terraform provider for managing OpenAI API Platform resources as infrastructure as code. Provision and manage projects, users, groups, roles, access assignments, service accounts, certificates, invitations, and project-level rate limits.

item.title: We’re launching Lyria 3.5 in Google Flow Music, with advances across musicality, lyrics, vocals, and creative control
item.description: We’re launching Lyria 3.5 in Google Flow Music, with advances across musicality, lyrics, vocals, and creative control

item.title: Default model enablement for Copilot Business and Enterprise
item.description: We’re introducing a global default enablement policy for generally available Copilot models on Copilot Business and Copilot Enterprise plans. Instead of requiring admins to manually turn on each new model as it ships, models that become generally available will now be on by default.

item.title: Copilot code review: Agent skills and MCP now generally available
item.description: Copilot code review support for agent skills and MCP servers is now generally available for all Copilot Pro, Pro+, Business, and Enterprise users. Previously announced in public preview, these capabilities let you bring your team’s tools, standards, and external context directly into every code review.

item.title: Scientific computing in the age of agentic AI
item.description: A new field report shows how scientists use AI coding agents to modernize scientific computing, accelerating software development and discovery in genomics and beyond.

item.title: GPT Transcribe, GPT Live Transcribe
item.description: Released GPT Transcribe for accurate file transcription and final transcripts of committed Realtime turns, along with GPT Live Transcribe for low-latency streaming transcription. Both models support free-form transcription context, keyword hints, and multiple expected input languages.

item.title: Gemini Robotics 2 brings whole body intelligence to robots
item.description: Gemini Robotics 2 brings whole body intelligence to robots

item.title: Gemini API Managed Agents: 3.6 Flash, hooks, and more
item.description: We’re announcing even more new capabilities in Managed Agents in Gemini API so developers can build reliable, production-ready agents.

item.title: 5 ways AI Mode in Search helps you enjoy the real world
item.description: It might sound counterintuitive, but Search's AI tools can actually help you make the most of your time offline whether you want to book concert tickets or find the perf…

item.title: Grok 4.5 is now available in GitHub Copilot
item.description: Grok 4.5, xAI’s latest reasoning model, is now rolling out in GitHub Copilot. It is designed for fast, agentic coding and complex multi-step workflows, with a context window of up to 500,000 tokens, support for text and image inputs, as well as low, medium, and high reasoning effort.

item.title: GitHub Copilot app usage metrics now expand across report rollups
item.description: Copilot app usage is now reported across much more of the Copilot usage metrics API. Individual Copilot app activity is now attributed to users in the enterprise-user and organization-user reports.

item.title: GitHub Copilot for JetBrains adds improved OpenTelemetry configuration and model management
item.description: This update brings more control and clarity to your GitHub Copilot for JetBrains workflows. You can now connect MCP servers and custom agents in Claude agent flows, tune telemetry and token settings for advanced scenarios, and work with a cleaner chat and model-selection experience.

item.title: How AI is expanding what people do at work
item.description: New OpenAI research shows how AI is expanding what workers do, with ChatGPT users taking on tasks across roles and reshaping job boundaries.

item.title: Manage GitHub Copilot app access with a dedicated policy
item.description: The GitHub Copilot app now has its own policy, so you can control who has access to it at the enterprise and organization levels. Until now, access to the Copilot app depended on your GitHub Copilot CLI policy being enabled.

item.title: Enterprise managed settings in the GitHub Copilot app and Copilot cloud agent
item.description: You can now govern the GitHub Copilot app and Copilot cloud agent with enterprise managed settings, the same centrally managed policies you use to control Copilot across your enterprise. With a managed-settings.json file, enterprise owners define one set of guardrails, such as which plugins and marketplaces developers can use and whether they can bypass approval prompts.

item.title: Our position on open-weights models
item.description: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei on open-weights models

item.title: Expanding our partnership with Cognizant | Anthropic
item.description: Cognizant embeds Claude across its platforms, with 30,000+ associates trained, and becomes a Global Premier Partner in the Claude Partner Network.

item.title: Claude Opus 5 is now available in GitHub Copilot
item.description: Claude Opus 5, Anthropic’s newest Opus model, is now available in GitHub Copilot. It is designed for complex, long-running coding tasks that require careful reasoning, effective tool use, and reliable execution across multiple steps.

item.title: high
item.description: On Claude Opus 5, disabling thinking is allowed only at effort high or below: thinking: {"type": "disabled"} with effort xhigh or max returns a 400 error, a breaking change from Claude Opus 4.8. See What's new in Claude Opus 5.

item.title: fallbacks
item.description: The fallbacks parameter now supports a "default" mode, which applies Anthropic's recommended fallback models by refusal category. Server-side fallback is in beta, and the "default" mode requires the server-side-fallback-2026-07-01 beta header. See Refusals and fallback.

item.title: mid-conversation-tool-changes-2026-07-01
item.description: Mid-conversation tool changes are now in beta on Claude Fable 5, Claude Mythos 5, Claude Opus 4.8, and Claude Opus 5: add or remove tools between turns of a conversation while preserving the prompt cache. Include the mid-conversation-tool-changes-2026-07-01 beta header in your requests.

item.title: claude-opus-4-7
item.description: We've removed fast mode for Claude Opus 4.7. Requests to claude-opus-4-7 with speed: "fast" now return an error; unlike Claude Opus 4.6, they do not fall back to standard speed. Claude Opus 4.7 itself remains available at standard speed. To continue using fast mode, migrate to Claude Opus 5 or Claude Opus 4.8. Read more in Fast mode.

item.title: low
item.description: Effort is the primary control for steering Claude Opus 5: the model supports the full ladder ( low, medium, high, xhigh, max ), with max for capability-critical work.

item.title: Introducing Claude Opus 5
item.description: Opus 5 is a step change improvement for the Opus tier powering long-running agents while delivering improvements in coding and professional work.

item.title: Launching Health in ChatGPT
item.description: Health in ChatGPT now lets eligible U.S. users securely connect medical records and Apple Health to get more personalized insights and better understand their health.

item.title: GitHub Mobile: Fix failing Actions checks with Copilot cloud agent
item.description: Now when a GitHub Actions check fails on your pull request, you can ask Copilot coding agent to investigate and directly fix the problem from GitHub Mobile. From the failed check, select Fix with Copilot to start the process.

item.title: GitHub MCP Server supports the next MCP specification
item.description: The MCP protocol is going stateless on 28th July 2026, and the GitHub MCP Server supports the latest spec ahead of the official release. What’s changing The new stateless core means MCP deployments are now easy to scale.

item.title: Copilot cloud agent for Linear is now generally available
item.description: You can now assign issues in Linear to Copilot cloud agent, our asynchronous, autonomous background agent. When you assign a Linear issue to Copilot, it will: Analyze the issue contents and open a draft pull request.

item.title: Agent automation controls in GitHub Issues in public preview
item.description: Agent automations increasingly label, type, assign, and close issues for you. GitHub Issues now shows the reason behind each change and lets you review them before they’re applied, so you decide how much to automate and when to stay in the loop.

item.title: NTT DATA Group cuts incident analysis to 30 minutes with Codex
item.description: NTT DATA Group uses ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex to help 9,000 employees automate work, cut incident analysis to 30 minutes, and scale secure AI adoption.

item.title: Introducing OpenAI Presence
item.description: Introducing OpenAI Presence, a proven enterprise AI agent platform that helps organizations deploy trusted voice and chat agents for customer and internal workflows.

item.title: How news organizations are using AI to advance their vital missions
item.description: News organizations are using AI to strengthen reporting, grow audiences, and improve business operations, with OpenAI tools supporting journalists and publishers worldwide.

item.title: Building AI infrastructure with the Effingham County community
item.description: OpenAI announces Project Camellia in Effingham County, Georgia, with commitments to responsible energy, community investment, jobs, and access to Codex.

item.title: Advancing the next era of national science
item.description: OpenAI outlines its commitment to advancing American science working with the U.S. Department of Energy and national labs to use frontier AI to accelerate discovery.

item.title: 3 Google updates from Galaxy Unpacked 2026
item.description: We shared how Samsung users can boost productivity and get time back on new foldables, watches, and glasses coming soon.
